node.statement: The lower C*-axiom in epsilon-banach-cstar-norm-axioms gives ||Z^dagger Z|| >= (1-e)||Z||^2 in each ambient amplification; the triangle inequality with the preceding compressed-product estimate yields ||Z^dagger dot Z|| >= (1-(K_dot+1)e)||Z||^2, so take K_sq=K_dot+1 and e_sq=e_dot.
